UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents the user's profile and UI configuration settings.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

photoURL.description: Optional URL to the user's avatar image.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the user account was created.

compactMode.description: Whether compact layout spacing is enabled.

aiModel.description: The chosen AI model for suggestions.

Activity.title: Activity
Activity.description: Represents a single system or user activity log entry.

id.description: Unique identifier of the activity log.

type.description: Type of activity (e.g., system, auth, resume).

text.description: Descriptive text of the action performed.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp of when the activity occurred.

Resume.title: Resume
Resume.description: Metadata for an uploaded resume file.

name.description: The name of the file uploaded.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.

uploadedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the file was uploaded.

url.description: URL to access the file from storage.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles and configuration documents.

/users/{userId}/activity/{activityId}.description: Collection of user's local and system activity logs.

/users/{userId}/resumes/{resumeId}.description: Collection of resumes uploaded by the user.
